description: This source file defines the DriverFactory class responsible for managing Selenium WebDriver instances for browser automation testing. It encapsulates WebDriver creation, configuration, and lifecycle management, supporting Chrome and Firefox browsers with options for headless or visible mode, and ensures thread safety via ThreadLocal storage.

classes.name: DriverFactory
classes.description: Provides thread-safe creation, configuration, and cleanup of WebDriver instances for browser automation tests. Supports Chrome and Firefox with configurable headless mode and maintains WebDriver lifecycle via ThreadLocal.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Returns the WebDriver instance for the current thread, creating and configuring it if necessary.

methods.name: quitDriver
methods.description: Quits and removes the WebDriver instance for the current thread, releasing resources.

methods.name: createDriver
methods.description: Creates a new WebDriver instance based on configured browser type and headless setting.

methods.name: logExecutionMode
methods.description: Logs and displays current execution mode details, including environment variables and headless/visible mode.

methods.name: createChromeDriver
methods.description: Initializes Chrome WebDriver with options tailored for headless or visible execution, including additional Chrome flags.

methods.name: createFirefoxDriver
methods.description: Initializes Firefox WebDriver with options for headless or visible mode.

methods.name: configureDriver
methods.description: Sets standard WebDriver configurations such as timeouts and window size.
